mode: Read-only PE/CLR metadata and CIL decoding. No DLL execution, login, game process or server emulation.
raw_dump_notes: final_core, closure, deeper and conditions use method-relative IL branch labels. Earlier core and binding dumps have method-relative instruction offsets but branch operands retain dncil body offsets (include method header). Do not use their branch operand integers as IL labels. Method tokens and call-site offsets are exact.
